g.text: Replacing cold directional arrows with living, breathing jelly physics.
Unblocked jellies open sparkling star eyes with golden aura;
blocked jellies rest peacefully with closed lids (zero visual noise).
Pure Kotlin grid engine runs mathematical reverse-slide
generation guaranteeing zero unsolvable puzzle dead-ends.
Launching jellies fracture ice cubes (2 HP) & honey pots.
Water Jets bend escape trajectories around corners!
paired with native Apple CoreHaptics & Android vibration waveforms.
